purpose: Verify study-area NASA weather and exact wheat crop-season windows; no fitting or invented soil sampling dates
representative_point_rule: Use the first catalog point for every year as an explicitly regional proxy; no verified annual field assignment or plot-level weather claim
restrictions: Crop-season aggregates use verified wheat planting through harvest inclusive
